note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF campground on the Battle Highway (WY-70) 18 miles west of Encampment, at about 8,800 ft. Small sites among conifers and meadow; the FS says trailers under 22 ft, at the edge for a 23-ft rig, though the driveways run 25-99 ft. No trash service. The Baby Lakes Trail into the Huston Park Wilderness starts across the highway; ATV riding on Forest Road 811 nearby. --Claude
summary: FS (updated 2026-10-22) + rec.gov 10243253 read: 13 sites, 7 reservable (7-13) in the peak season, $20, 1 vault toilet, no potable water per FS, no hookups, 14-day limit; season widened to mid-June..October (closes 09-30 -> 10-31). FS 'trailers under 22 ft' passes (22-ft ruling). Not waterfront holds; pin fine; phone confirmed.
flags: FIT (criteria, report): FS and rec.gov both say '13 small campsites for trailers under 22'' - passes under the AWH 2026-10-20 22-ft ruling (trailer limits apply to the motorhome); driveways 25-99 ft (004 is 25 ft).
